meta.title: Zelvo
meta.description: Bilingual IT service management for the UAE.

welcome.subtitle: IT service management designed for Arabic and English, hosted on your own servers.
welcome.setupNotice: This is the empty starter application. Features arrive module by module in Phase 1.

preferences.heading: Language and region
preferences.intro: Choose how Zelvo shows text, dates and numbers to you. Your choices apply only to you; the language switch at the top changes the language for this visit only.

language.intro: These defaults apply to everyone who has not chosen their own in their profile, and to visitors who are not signed in. Visitors whose browser asks for English or Arabic see that language.

language.neverChanged: Not changed yet: the platform defaults apply.

translations.intro: Each of these needs a value in both languages before go-live. Until then, screens show the language that is available.
translations.none: Every text has both an English and an Arabic version.
